verdict.rationale: GlitchTip ingests events from Sentry's open-source SDKs, claims Sentry API compatibility, and lets users inspect stack traces and event data, so SDK-side enrichment plausibly reaches it. However, no evidence explicitly documents breadcrumbs, custom tags, or user context being received or displayed. missing for 10: explicit documentation of breadcrumb ingestion and display, custom tag support and filtering, user context on events, and hands-on corroboration that this enrichment survives into GlitchTip issues.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach breadcrumbs, custom tags, and user context to every event so a stack trace arrives with the state that produced it

citations.quote: GlitchTip can use Sentry's open source SDKs to receive error data from your application.
GlitchTip aims to be Sentry API compatible. Anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip.
Browse issues, inspect stack traces and event data, and resolve issues
